name: Chloroform

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 11 other countries, first in 1976 — for cancer risk and liver harm

fda.text: Consult a doctor if condition worsens or symptoms persist. Keep out of the reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a poison control center right away. summary: Chloroform was pulled from the market in the United States and 11 other countries starting in 1976 due to liver harm and carcinogenicity, which means the ability to cause cancer [3]. Official warnings state to keep it away from children, seek immediate medical care or call poison control for an overdose, consult a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen, and speak with a healthcare professional before use if pregnant or breastfeeding [4]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated low risk scores of 4 for the liver and 15 for the heart [M].
